highlights.name: Spiral arm
highlights.description: Look across the tilted disk as the cluster comes into view.

highlights.name: Cluster pass
highlights.description: Compare the nearby warm stars with the distant spiral.

highlights.name: Galaxy panorama
highlights.description: Look back across the spiral from the halo.

highlights.name: Blue cloud approach
highlights.description: See the blue glow against the distant stellar field.

highlights.name: Among the filaments

highlights.name: Violet cloud reveal
highlights.description: Look toward the violet cloud after the curved passage.

landmarks.name: Amber star
landmarks.description: A warm-colored model star close enough to show clear parallax as you move.

landmarks.name: Blue star
landmarks.description: A blue-white model star. Compare its apparent direction and frequency shift at different traveler speeds.

landmarks.name: Pale star
landmarks.description: A more distant model star for comparing perspective and changing lines of sight.

landmarks.name: Blue emission region
landmarks.description: A nearby model of layered glowing filaments. Its colors and brightness are illustrative; the gaps represent reduced emission, not measured dust extinction.

landmarks.name: Violet emission region
landmarks.description: A larger generated cloud beyond the blue region. Move sideways to compare foreground filaments with the distant stellar background.

landmarks.name: Galactic center
landmarks.description: The central bulge of this spiral model. The approach stops outside the bright central region.

landmarks.name: Inner spiral arm
landmarks.description: A survey point within a spiral arm, where the disk has visible thickness and depth.

landmarks.name: Outer disk
landmarks.description: A survey point near the outer edge of the tilted disk. Look back toward the central bulge.

landmarks.name: Halo cluster 1
landmarks.description: A compact generated group of warm stars in the spiral model’s halo. Its position and members are illustrative teaching scenery.
